articles.title: Chainalysis beats most Celsius claims, but ‘audit’ lawsuit survives
articles.description: Chainalysis still faces an aiding-and-abetting claim over Celsius’ disputed $3.3 billion audit after a judge dismissed 15 other claims.

articles.title: Oil prices rise as Chinese refiners reportedly ban October fuel exports; Brent crude back above $100
articles.description: It comes after a report that Chinese refiners suspended October fuel exports to protect domestic supplies.

articles.title: EU Presses Binance Over ‘Reverse Solicitation’ Exemption for Users: Report
articles.description: Regulators are probing how the exchange keeps serving EU customers from Abu Dhabi, months after it lost its MiCA registrations.

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2002 as global bond rout gathers pace
articles.description: Treasury yields were higher on Thursday amid a global sell-off in government debt.

articles.title: The U.S. just made it much easier for retail investors to access private markets
articles.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission has approved new plans to open private markets up to retail investors.

articles.title: Russia launches massive strikes on Ukraine’s energy grid, forcing power cuts ahead of winter
articles.description: Seven people were killed in the attack and emergency power cuts were imposed in Kyiv and three other regions.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $6.3B in Q3 as BTC price rises nearly 43%
articles.description: Bitcoin gained 42.71% in Q3, its best third-quarter performance since 2017, as US spot ETFs attracted $6.34 billion in net inflows.

articles.title: MetaMask security incident forces Ethereum staking exits, no funds at risk
articles.description: An Ethereum security researcher estimates about 0.36 ETH in rewards was diverted, while precautionary exits cover validators holding roughly 523,000 ETH.

articles.title: Bitcoin think tank questions MSCI’s ‘invisible committee’ over Strategy, Metaplanet rule
articles.description: A Bitcoin Policy Institute paper says MSCI’s proposed “non-operating company” rule could remove Strategy and Metaplanet from its indexes and may have roots in an earlier crypto treasury review.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: South Korean President Lee pushes back on Alaska LNG project after Trump touts Seoul's participation
articles.description: The U.S. announced plans for up to $200 billion in South Korean investment, though Seoul has yet to finalize the participation in the Alaska LNG project.

articles.title: UK Prime Minister Burnham says Iran 'played a part' in British air base incident
articles.description: RAF Fairford has been used as the U.S. Air Force's command outpost for operations from Europe and for American strikes on Iranian missile sites.

articles.title: Dogecoin gets DeFi testnet as DogeOS bets miners will eventually secure its apps
articles.description: DogeOS wants to turn DOGE into more than a payments and speculation asset, but its applications still rely on selected operators rather than Dogecoin miners.

articles.title: Crypto hacks top $768M in September, worst month of 2026
articles.description: The $388 million Bitget breach and $320 million Liquid Network exploit accounted for most of September’s losses, though more than $270 million from the latter was later returned.

articles.title: Bitcoin's soft-inflation pop to $85,500 fades as bond yields refuse to fall
articles.description: A cooler-than-expected PCE report sent bitcoin briefly above $85,000 on Wednesday. Treasury yields held near their highest since 2002 and the gains drained away.

articles.title: In photos: China's Xi hardens Taiwan warning as country celebrates week-long National Day holiday
articles.description: China began its seven-day National Day holiday on Thursday after President Xi Jinping used his annual speech to sharpen Beijing's message on Taiwan.

articles.title: AI race heats up as OpenAI flags alleged model-copying campaign
articles.description: OpenAI says it identified an attempt to extract protected reasoning from its AI models, linking part of the activity with China’s Moonshot AI.

articles.title: Trump’s AI lunch included every major tech company. Except Apple
articles.description: Apple's absence from Trump's AI lunch raised eyebrows, but the company is known to look out for its own interests.

articles.title: Passengers and crew foil co-pilot's apparent attempt to crash FlyDubai flight to Israel
articles.description: One of the pilots on a FlyDubai flight headed for Israel stabbed the second pilot, according to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

articles.title: CFTC seeks to define event contracts as swaps amid prediction market fight
articles.description: The classification could assist the CFTC’s claim that it has exclusive federal jurisdiction over event contracts offered on regulated prediction markets.
